title: Editable Video Context: Mid-Context KV-Cache Reuse for Context-Managing Video LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.18718v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Context Language Models let a model edit its own context, while Suffix Cache Reuse makes edits to text efficient by adjusting the positions of cached keys for surviving tokens. We extend these ideas to video language models with multimodal rotary position embeddings (M-RoPE). We represent a long video as timestamped segments. After viewing a sparsely sampled version, the model selects segments for decoding at 4x the frame rate, and the remaining segments are removed from its context. Our rebuild method reuses the KV cache of surviving segments by rotating their keys with a single offset shared by the temporal, height, and width components of Qwen2.5-VL's M-RoPE. A content-hashed cache also avoids repeating vision-encoder computation for those segments. In preliminary experiments with Qwen2.5-VL-7B on synthetic needle-in-a-video-haystack questions over public-domain films, the method reduces prefill tokens and end-to-end rebuild latency

translated_title: 可编辑视频上下文：面向上下文管理视频大语言模型的上下文中KV缓存复用
translated_abstract: 上下文语言模型让模型能够编辑自己的上下文，而后缀缓存复用通过调整存活token的缓存键位置，使文本编辑变得高效。我们将这些思想扩展到具有多模态旋转位置嵌入的视频语言模型。我们将长视频表示为带时间戳的片段。在查看稀疏采样版本后，模型选择部分片段以4倍帧率进行解码，其余片段则从其上下文中移除。我们的重建方法通过使用Qwen2.5-VL的M-RoPE中时间、高度和宽度分量共享的单个偏移量来旋转键，从而复用存活片段的KV缓存。内容哈希缓存还避免了为这些片段重复进行视觉编码器计算。在使用Qwen2.5-VL-7B对公有领域电影进行合成“视频大海捞针”问题的初步实验中，该方法减少了预填充token数量和端到端重建延迟。
tldr: 该论文提出面向视频大语言模型的可编辑上下文方法，通过M-RoPE时间、高度、宽度分量共享的单个偏移量旋转键值以实现上下文中段的KV缓存复用，并结合内容哈希缓存避免重复视觉编码计算，从而显著降低长视频管理的预填充token数量与重建延迟。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an editable video context method for video LLMs that reuses mid-context KV cache by rotating keys with a single shared offset across M-RoPE's temporal, height, and width components, combined with content-hashed caching to avoid vision-encoder recomputation, reducing prefill tokens and end-to-end rebuild latency for long-video context management.
